observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with the 'PS4' logo visible on the front right.
Two blue boxes are placed on top of the console: one labeled 'God of War' and 'Wireless Controller for P4', the other labeled 'FIFA' and 'Wireless Controller for P4'.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not the 'fat' (Slim) variant, as the 'PS4' logo is visible on the front.
The console has a glossy finish with some smudges and minor wear.
The boxes are branded 'PLAYX' and appear to be third-party accessories, not official PlayStation products.
No games are visible inside the console or on the screen.
No cables, power adapter, or other accessories are shown.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4, which is less valuable than a 'fat' (Slim) model.

risks.proof: A video or photo showing the console powered on, with the home screen visible and games listed.
